question_text: What must you remember as bus driver on duty?

options.text: - not have any beverages containing alcohol while on duty and while on stand-by duty
- not start to drive while under the effect of alcohol
- have beverages containing alcohol while on duty, as long as a blood alcohol standard of 0.3 per mille is not exceeded

correct_answers.text: - not have any beverages containing alcohol while on duty and while on stand-by duty
- not start to drive while under the effect of alcohol

question_text: What must you remember as bus driver on duty?

options.text: You may not take any drugs or medicaments which impair your ability to drive while on duty or stand-by duty
You may not start to drive when your ability to drive is impaired by drugs or medicaments
You may take any drug for which no prescription is required, without having to fear that your ability to drive is impaired

correct_answers.text: You may not take any drugs or medicaments which impair your ability to drive while on duty or stand-by duty
You may not start to drive when your ability to drive is impaired by drugs or medicaments
